name: agent-board
description: A local Beads workspace for ChatGPT desktop.

interface.longDescription: Plan, organize and review local Beads issues inside ChatGPT desktop. Switch between Board, List and dependency Graph views, attach issues to chat and hand work to a new ChatGPT conversation. Requires Bun, Beads and a local desktop execution environment.
interface.defaultPrompt: Open AgentBoard and help me plan the next work for my local project.
